text.body: || daśaślokīstutiḥ || sāmbo naḥ kuladaivataṃ paśupate sāmba tvadīyā vayaṃ sāmbaṃ staumi surāsuroragagaṇāssāmbena santāritāḥ| sāmbāyāstu namo mayā viracitaṃ sāmbātparaṃ no bhaje sāmbasyānucaro'smyahaṃ mama ratissāmbe parabrahmaṇi || viṣṇvādyāśca puratrayaṃ suragaṇā jetuṃ na śaktāssvayaṃ yaṃ śambhu bhagavanvayaṃ tu paśavo'smākaṃ tvameveśvaraḥ | sālalāniyojitāssumanassvasthā babhūvustatastasminme hṛdayaṃ sukhena ramatāṃ sāmbe parabrahmaṇi ||2 kṣoṇī yasya ratho rathāṅgayugalaṃ candrārkabimbadvayaṃ kodaṇḍaḥ kanakācalo harirabhūdbāṇo vidhissārathiḥ| tūṇīro jaladhirhayāśśruticayo maurvī bhujaṅgādhipastasminme...|| 3 yenāpāditamaṅgajāṅgabhasitaṃ divyāṅgarāgaissramaṃ yena svīkṛtamabjasambhavaśirassauvarṇapātraissamaṃ | yenāṅgīkṛtamacyutasya nayanaṃ pūjāraviṃdassamaṃ tasminme ...|| govindādadhikaṃ na devatamiti proccārya hastāvubhāvuddhṛtyātha śivasya sannidhigato vyāso munīnāṃ puraḥ| yasya stambhitapāṇirānavikṛtā nandīśvareṇābhavattasminme ... || 5 ākāśaśca kuṭhāyate daśa diśābhogo dukūlāyate śītāṃśuḥ prasavāyate sthiratarānandaḥ svarūpāyate | vedānto nilayāyate suvinayo yasya svabhāvāyate tasminme ... || 6 viṣṇuryasya sahasranāmaniyamādambhoruhāṇyarcayannekonopaciteṣu netrakamalaṃ naijaṃ padābjadvayam | sampūjyāsurasaṃhatiṃ vidalayaṃstrailokyapālo'bhavattasminme ...|| 7 śauriṃ satyagiraṃ varāhavapuṣaṃ pādāmbujādarśane cakre yo dayayā samastajagatāṃ nāthaṃ śirodarśane | midhyāvācamapūjyameva satataṃ haṃsasvarūpaṃ vidhiṃ tasminme ...|| 8 yasyāsandharaṇījalāgnipavanavyomārkacandrādayo vikhyātāstanavo'ṣṭadhā pariṇatā nānyattato vartate| oṃkārārthavivekinī śrutiriyaṃ cācaṣṭa turyaṃ śivaṃ tasminme ...|| 9 viṣṇubrahmasurādhipaprabhṛtayassarve'pi devāsurāsambhūtājjaladherviṣātparibhavaṃ prāptā yametyeśvaram | yānārtaṃścharaṇāgatāniti surā nyo'rakṣadardhakṣaṇāttasminme ...|| 10 || iti śrīmacchaṅkarācāryaviracitā daśaślokīstutiḥ sampūrṇā ||
